items.title: SpaceX’s $1T Goal and 3 More Shockers From Musk on the Earnings Call
items.summary: SpaceX  and  Tesla  CEO Elon Musk is famous for his sky-high ambitions, including reaching Mars one day.  After SpaceX’s earnings report Tuesday, Musk laid out four more brazen goals for the rocket and artificial-intelligence company, including reaching $1 trillion in revenue in less than five years.  SpaceX stock tumbled about 14% to $108.27, down 10 cents from Friday’s closing price.
